description.value: Kelowna Actors Studio is a 200-seat professional theatre established in 2003 in Kelowna's Cultural District, producing Broadway-style musicals and hosting youth education programs. The venue offers a dinner-and-show experience with full table service — including appetizers, mains, wines, and cocktails — alongside traditional theatre-style seating. Voted the Okanagan's Favourite Theatre Company and Best Arts Organization, it sits directly across from the Kelowna Public Library in a former packinghouse building.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is actively operating with a robust 2026–2027 season. Phone (+1 250-862-2867), address (1379 Ellis Street, Kelowna BC V1Y 1Z9), and website all match OSM tags exactly. The site describes an on-site kitchen and licensed bar with full dinner table service for mainstage productions, confirming food on site; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill is found anywhere in the fetched content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible professional theatre with confirmed 2026–2027 programming and an on-site dining experience — a worthwhile stop for touring cyclists visiting Kelowna's Cultural District.

Café or food on site.detail: On-site kitchen and licensed bar with full dinner table service for evening performances; themed menu per production includes appetizers, mains, beverages, wines, and cocktails. Complimentary dessert served during intermission for table seating guests

wow_evidence: 200-seat professional dinner theatre producing Broadway-style musicals; show-conditional evening out.
